# teams_room_video_tele_conferencing_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing RoomVideoTeleConferencingPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `area_code` (String) Maps to the -AreaCode parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `place_external_calls` (String) Maps to the -PlaceExternalCalls parameter.
- `place_internal_calls` (String) Maps to the -PlaceInternalCalls parameter.
- `receive_external_calls` (String) Maps to the -ReceiveExternalCalls parameter.
- `receive_internal_calls` (String) Maps to the -ReceiveInternalCalls parameter.
